newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Astra 1996 net 470 bln rph - report.
newsitem.headline: Astra 1996 net 470 bln rph - report.

text.p: Indonesia's largest automobile manufacturer PT Astra International made a net profit of around 470 billion rupiah in 1996, the Indonesian Observer newspaper said on Monday.
The newspaper quoted the company's finance director, Rini Suwandi, as saying that net profit in 1997 could reach 714 billion rupiah.
Company officials said annual results were not likely to be announced until mid-April and added that the figures quoted by Suwandi were indicative. They gave no more details.
Suwandi was also quoted as saying that the company would post net profit of 1.5 trillion rupiah by the year 2000.
She said that in 1996 the company's motorcycle division contributed 40 percent of total profits, while the motor vehicles division contributed 35 percent.
She said also that the company's agri-business division was expanding and could be spun off as a separate company and floated on the exchange in the last quarter this year.
She said Astra expected to be producing crude palm oil from 300,000 hectares of estates by the turn of the century, up from the current 180,000 hectares being cultivated currently.
